classifications.rationale: The President only recounts a determination made in an earlier proclamation; this segment neither directs present agency action nor itself creates a new legal consequence.
The President recounts the prior extension of the safeguard and subsequent statutory, agency, and private-party events; any legal consequence occurred under earlier action, not through this segment.
classifications.evidence: I further determined to extend the safeguard measure proclaimed in Proclamation 9693

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory positive-adjustment determination concerning the domestic industry; the legally significant determination occurs in this segment itself.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that the domestic industry has been making and is continuing to make a positive adjustment to import competition

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes determinations that the prior exclusion impaired the safeguard and that modification is necessary; these statutory determinations occur in the segment itself, even though the operative tariff modification follows.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that imports of bifacial panels have surged in recent years

classifications.rationale: The President directly modifies the HTS, fixes the effective date, and creates a conditional tariff exemption with importer duties; those legal consequences arise from the proclamation itself.
classifications.evidence: subchapter III of chapter 99 of the HTS is modified as set forth in Annex I to this proclamation

classifications.rationale: The President directly subjects nonqualifying bifacial panels to the safeguard tariff upon covered entry or withdrawal; the tariff consequence follows by force of this provision itself.
classifications.evidence: such bifacial panels shall be subject to the safeguard tariff

classifications.rationale: This combined segment inseparably includes internal implementation direction to CBP, a self-executing future deletion of tariff provisions, and internal supersession of inconsistent presidential directives, so no single posture reliably covers it.
classifications.evidence: the U.S. note and tariff provisions established in Annex I to this proclamation shall be deleted from the HTS
